title: Ram Mandir Scandal: Investigation into Alleged Corruption and Employment Scams
summary: The investigation into the Ram Mandir scandal has revealed allegations of corruption and employment scams. The police are investigating claims that employees were hired through corrupt means, with some reports suggesting that the trust's chairman, Anil Mishra, was involved in the process. The police have also found evidence of cash transactions and are questioning suspects.
summary_points: The Ram Mandir scandal has led to allegations of corruption and employment scams.
The police are investigating claims that employees were hired through corrupt means.
Some reports suggest that the trust's chairman, Anil Mishra, was involved in the process.
The police have found evidence of cash transactions and are questioning suspects.
The investigation is ongoing, with new developments emerging regularly.
title_hi: राम मंदिर चोरी: जांच में बड़ा खुलासा
summary_hi: राम मंदिर चोरी मामले में आरोपियों के दावे और पुलिस की जांच में नए विकास आ रहे हैं।
summary_points_hi: राम मंदिर चोरी मामले में आरोपियों ने कई दावे किए हैं।
पुलिस बरामदगी, आर्थिक गतिविधियों और अन्य पहलुओं की जांच कर रही है।
कुछ रिपोर्टें सुझाती हैं कि ट्रस्ट के अध्यक्ष, अनिल मिश्रा, इस प्रक्रिया में शामिल थे।
पुलिस ने नकद लेनदेन और संदिग्ध व्यक्तियों पर सवाल उठाए हैं।
जांच अभी भी जारी है, और नए विकास नियमित रूप से आ रहे हैं।

framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the alleged corruption and employment scams, emphasizing the need for strong action against those involved. They also highlight the role of the trust's chairman in the process and the potential consequences for the organization.
